questions.scenario: Your family is planning a long road trip in an Innova to your hometown. What is your main contribution?

options.text: Checking the car's tyre pressure, engine oil, and making sure all the heavy luggage is securely packed in the boot.
Using Google Maps to calculate the exact distance, total toll tax, and how much petrol money will be needed.
Finding the most scenic route that passes through the best green highways and the famous dhabas for parathas.
Negotiating the per-kilometer rate with the local taxi vendor to get the best possible deal for the trip.

questions.scenario: You are traveling on the Indian Railways (like Shatabdi or Rajdhani). What are you doing?

options.text: Looking at the massive electric engine at the station and chatting with the TT about how the train operates.
Constantly refreshing the 'Where is my Train' app to see exactly how many kilometers you have covered and the current speed.
Looking at the railway map in the magazine, fascinated by how the tracks perfectly interconnect thousands of Indian cities.
Wondering how the railway makes a profit from selling cheap passenger tickets compared to the massive goods trains.

questions.scenario: Your school bus ride back home is always chaotic. What do you usually do?

options.text: Checking with the bus uncle (driver) to make sure the rattling noise in the engine isn't something serious.
Noting down exactly how many minutes the bus wastes at each stop and predicting exactly when you'll reach home.
Looking out the window and realizing a smarter shortcut through the colony could save the bus 15 minutes of traffic.
Calculating how much transport fee the school collects from 40 students versus the monthly cost of diesel.

questions.scenario: You book an Ola or Uber during peak Indian summer. What catches your attention?

options.text: Immediately checking if the AC is cooling properly, the seatbelts work, and the car looks well-maintained.
Staring at the app's live GPS tracker, analyzing the driver's turn-by-turn movement as he comes to pick you up.
Getting annoyed at the messy society pickup gate and mentally designing a much smoother drop-off/pick-up lane.
Opening Ola, Uber, and Rapido simultaneously to compare fares and snag the cheapest ride possible.

questions.scenario: You are on the highway and see a massive, beautifully decorated Indian truck with 'Horn OK Please' painted on the back.

options.text: Looking at its massive 18 wheels and wondering how the driver manages to shift gears on such a heavy machine.
Spotting the 'GPS Tracking Enabled' sticker and thinking about the control room monitoring its highway speed.
Admiring the bright, colorful truck art, the hanging tassels, and how it represents Indian road culture.
Imagining what it would be like to own a fleet of 50 such trucks and getting delivery contracts from Amazon or Flipkart.

questions.scenario: You order late-night food on Swiggy or Zomato, but it's raining outside.

options.text: Feeling bad for the delivery guy, offering him a glass of water, and checking if his scooter is handling the rain okay.
Tracking the live map constantly to see if the rider took a wrong turn and calculating the exact delay time.
Thinking about how the app's algorithm could group orders together so one rider delivers to your whole building at once.
Wondering how much 'surge pricing' the app charged you and how much of that actually goes to the delivery partner.

questions.scenario: Your family is shifting to a new rented flat and you hired Packers & Movers.

options.text: Standing near the Tata Ace (Chota Hathi) making sure the workers strap the heavy fridge and TV safely with ropes.
Sharing the truck's live location on WhatsApp with your parents so they can track its exact progress to the new house.
Color-coding all the cardboard boxes with markers so the unloading process is incredibly smooth and organized.
Sitting with the manager to haggle over the final bill, labor charges, and making sure nothing was overcharged.

questions.scenario: You are playing a vehicle-based video game (like Asphalt, GTA, or Euro Truck Simulator). What is your play style?

options.text: Spending hours in the virtual garage customizing the engine, upgrading the suspension, and fixing car damage.
Constantly checking the mini-map, speedometer, and optimizing your lap times to beat your own high score.
Driving around the open-world map just to explore hidden shortcuts, new bridges, and beautiful scenic routes.
Completing missions just to earn maximum virtual money so you can buy the biggest garage and the most expensive cars.

questions.scenario: You are stuck in a massive, bumper-to-bumper traffic jam in your city.

options.text: Wishing you could get out and physically clear the blockage, or check if a broken-down bus is causing the whole mess.
Opening Google Maps to check how long the dark red traffic line is and calculating the exact delay in kilometers.
Mentally designing a new flyover or underpass layout that would completely solve this chokepoint forever.
Thinking about how much money and petrol is being wasted nationwide every single day because of poor traffic management.

questions.scenario: Your colony is organizing a group trip to a Water Park. What is your role?

options.text: Going down early to physically inspect the hired Tempo Traveler and ensuring the AC is chilling properly before everyone boards.
Calculating exactly what time everyone needs to wake up and board so you completely avoid peak morning highway traffic.
Making a fun, easy-to-read itinerary map for the group, highlighting which food courts and dhabas the bus will stop at.
Collecting the money from all 20 people and bargaining with the bus agency for a massive group discount.

Fleet_Supervisor.title: The Ground Commander (Fleet & Maintenance Supervisor)
Fleet_Supervisor.primary_match_text: You are an action-oriented, hands-on person! You care about how machines work, love being on the ground, and believe that a well-maintained vehicle is the backbone of any journey.
Fleet_Supervisor.day_in_the_life: Checking the health of a 100-truck fleet, talking to mechanics and drivers, preventing breakdowns before they happen, and ensuring cargo moves safely.
Fleet_Supervisor.alternative_match_text: Your love for vehicles and practical problem-solving makes you a great fit for Automobile Engineering, Workshop Management, or Defense Logistics.
Fleet_Supervisor.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th: Science or Commerce. Degree: B.Tech/Diploma in Automobile/Mechanical Engineering OR BBA in Logistics. Next Steps: Work hands-on with big transport fleets like BlueDart or VRL Logistics.

GPS_Analyst.title: The Tracking Wizard (Telematics & GPS Analyst)
GPS_Analyst.primary_match_text: You have a highly analytical brain! You love looking at data, tracking live locations, and calculating the most efficient way to do things using technology.
GPS_Analyst.day_in_the_life: Sitting in a high-tech control room, tracking thousands of trucks via GPS, analyzing fuel consumption data, and catching drivers who are overspeeding.
GPS_Analyst.alternative_match_text: Your data-driven mindset means you would also excel as a Data Analyst, Software Tester, or Supply Chain Executive.
GPS_Analyst.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th: Commerce with Math or Science. Degree: B.Sc in Statistics/Computer Science, BCA, or BBA. Next Steps: Learn Data Analytics, Excel, and SQL to work with tech-driven logistics companies like Delhivery or Ecom Express.

Network_Designer.title: The Route Architect (Transport Network Designer)
Network_Designer.primary_match_text: You are a creative and systemic thinker! You don't just want to move things; you want to design the smartest, most beautiful, and most efficient map to get them there.
Network_Designer.day_in_the_life: Using mapping software to design the most efficient delivery routes for thousands of Amazon packages, ensuring less traffic and faster delivery times across India.
Network_Designer.alternative_match_text: Your systemic creativity would also make you a brilliant Urban Planner, GIS Specialist, or Operations Architect.
Network_Designer.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th: Any Stream (Geography or Math is a plus). Degree: BBA in Supply Chain Management or B.Sc/BA in Geography/Urban Planning. Next Steps: Master supply chain modeling software and work for big e-commerce platforms.

Transport_Company_Owner.title: The Logistics Boss (Transport Company Owner)
Transport_Company_Owner.primary_match_text: You are a natural business leader and negotiator! You understand money, know how to secure big contracts, and love the idea of building your own massive empire.
Transport_Company_Owner.day_in_the_life: Meeting with huge clients to secure cargo contracts, managing the budget for a massive fleet of vehicles, and negotiating profits with drivers and vendors.
Transport_Company_Owner.alternative_match_text: Your supreme leadership and business skills would also make you a successful Entrepreneur, Sales Director, or Business Development Manager.
Transport_Company_Owner.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th: Commerce. Degree: BBA or B.Com. Next Steps: Pursue an MBA in Logistics & Supply Chain Management or Entrepreneurship to learn how to scale a massive transport business.
